name: Shirt Lab Free Icons & Game Assets
shortDescription: Search and download SVG icons, native PNG artwork, pixel art and game assets. Creator licences, Wiki pages and shirt designer links included.
pricingIntent: Free BASIC only, price 0, 500,000 requests/month, 1,000/hour. No paid tiers or Shirt Lab request overages. RapidAPI’s separate platform bandwidth fee above 10 GB cannot be edited in the provider plan UI; disclose it and offer public downloadUrl for artwork.
termsOfUse: API access is free. Each asset retains its original creator licence. Check license, licenseUrl and any per-asset terms before reuse; preserve required attribution. The SDK and original catalogue tooling are MIT-licensed; this does not relicense artwork. RapidAPI gateway limits and its separate platform bandwidth fees apply; direct public origin access remains free.
